confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate, not checked against live listings. Restaurant and café anchors are the most reliable. Hotel and hostel anchors are less certain because July is peak Algarve season and Faro has fewer hostels, so rates vary widely by location and booking lead time. Cocktail and wine are estimated from the local beer and restaurant price relationship rather than direct price knowledge.
comparable_city_reasoning: Basis is general knowledge of mid-sized Algarve and southern Portuguese coastal cities in peak summer, priced somewhat below Lisbon and in line with or slightly below Portimão and Lagos, with restaurant prices set at local, non-tourist venues.
